automated.summary: composed-relation (governed-joins task 2): the SQL builder gains a code-composed governed financial relation. When a DomainSpec carries the builder-only `composed` marker, sqlBuilder.ts emits WITH aliased actual_src/budget_src CTEs (selecting from the two real GL+month rollup views, Actual scoped by its plant='DUB' column inside the CTE, Budget structurally DUB) FULL OUTER JOINed on (gl_code, month), with COALESCE zero-fill cast to numeric(18,2) so Budget-only/Actual-only keys return type-consistent 0.00 - replacing the prior multi-gold-object throw; objectsTouched lists both source view leaves (and the deterministic CTE alias names) so the existing sqlValidator allow-list passes. A governed-financial read action ('report') is added to GRANT_ACTIONS, seeded to role admin in migrate.ts (migrate.test.ts updated), and enforced fail-closed at the shared executeResolved boundary together with the domain grant and every selected measure/dimension grant. Row scope is applied to BOTH sources: the Actual CTE by plant IN (user's validated scope), and the Budget CTE (no plant column, structurally DUB) by the trusted derived-constant guard `WHERE 'DUB' IN (user's validated scope)` — so a user authorized for the domain/action but scoped to a non-DUB plant (e.g. LON) receives ZERO Budget rows (closes a cross-scope disclosure). Freshness / dimension enumeration / RBAC scope-validation stay on the real source views and composed reconciliation is deferred (narrowed C1). Hermetic tests (test:hermetic, no DB): builder SQL shape (WITH/FULL OUTER JOIN/COALESCE::numeric casts, in-CTE Actual scope, both leaves in objectsTouched), validator compatibility (passes with both leaves allow-listed, rejects when a leaf is removed), and executor authorization (each denial branch + the fully-granted allow case). DEMONSTRATED host evidence (D-0008) against docker warehouse-db (127.0.0.1:5433): the WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1 gated leaf loads prior+replacement actuals across multiple cost centres and a budget batch via IngestionRepository and asserts the composed relation zero-fills Budget-only and Actual-only keys (0.00), nets a matched key (actual 125.00 + budget 200.00), and does NOT fan out Budget across multiple Actual cost centres. verify.py green; quality-gate green.
